import math
# Side profile of a rectangular 90 degree duct elbow, in the XZ plane.
def profile(ro, ri, ymin, depth):
    cx, cz, xe = 60, 30, 100
    return (cq.Workplane("XZ", origin=(0,ymin,0))
      .moveTo(cx-ro,0).lineTo(cx-ro,cz)
      .threePointArc((cx-ro/math.sqrt(2),cz+ro/math.sqrt(2)),(cx,cz+ro))
      .lineTo(xe,cz+ro).lineTo(xe,cz+ri).lineTo(cx,cz+ri)
      .threePointArc((cx-ri/math.sqrt(2),cz+ri/math.sqrt(2)),(cx-ri,cz))
      .lineTo(cx-ri,0).close().extrude(depth))
outer=profile(60,20,20,40)
inner=profile(58,22,18,36)
result=outer.cut(inner)
